DARV.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.0-0.a: Hey, there. You look a little lost.
DARV.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.0-1.c: I mean... it seems like every path I take leads upwards eventually. So I guess I can't be?
DARV.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.0-2.a:
Bah ha ha. That's one way of looking at it!
Here, take a little something from my collection. Maybe it'll help your climb.
Ain't found your way yet? See if somethin' speaks to ya!
DARV.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-0.c: Why do you keep handing out your stuff, anyway?
DARV.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-1.a:
You see all this I'm haulin'?
Treasures find their way to me faster than I can give 'em out!
DARV.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-2.a: I ain't made of storage space!
NEOW.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.0-1.a: [sine]Wouldn't it.. ..be stranger... if I were small?[/sine]
[sine]...your anger drives you... do not let it fade...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-0.c: Seriously, though. What the hell is that Architect guy's problem?
NEOW.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-2.c: Okay, okay, take it easy. Trust me, I noticed.
[bold]HEY WATCH IT GET YOUR HANDS OFF ME[/bold]

[i][font_size=22]In a few brief seconds, Nonupeipe's guards lay smoldering on the ground.
The Wildfire enters her domain more frazzled than triumphant.[/font_size][/i]
Don't you dare speak that way in front of me, young lady!

Oh! Shit. Giant woman. Um...
My deepest apologies, fair, uh. Maiden. I... didn't realize you were there.

Ugh. Stop embarrassing yourself, please.
And don't do any of this again.

Didn't your mother teach you how to act like a lady?
Never mind. I'll fill in if I must.

Despite my best efforts, you remain a vulgar and belligerent child.
It's quite demoralizing.
"Your best efforts?" All you've done is scold me and complain.
See? This is precisely what I'm talking about!
OROBAS.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.0-0: New puppet! Fire puppet!! Does fire hurt puppet?!
OROBAS.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.0-1: "Puppet?" The hell is that supposed to mean?
OROBAS.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.1-0:
Skeleton fire puppet! Armor fire puppet! Bird fire puppet!
You all have support group??
OROBAS.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-0: Hey, why do you keep calling me a puppet?
OROBAS.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-1:
Neow want you fight! You fight for Neow!
Is that not puppet?
OROBAS.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-2: Um... no? Neow didn't pick this fight for me. That asshole at the top picked it for himself.
OROBAS.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.3-0: Do you need fight? Why not try talk?
OROBAS.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.3-1: I literally tried talking and he killed me about it.
OROBAS.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.3-2: That not good! Maybe try talk better?
PAEL.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.0-0.a: [thinky_dots]This warmth... the flame lulls me back to slumber...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Your flame does not need to be your anger.
Be at peace, in warmth and comfort...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-0.a: [thinky_dots]I admit, young one... I find your presence strangely soothing...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-1.c:
Uhh. Yeah. Well. The way you doze off and melt into a puddle when I walk in is...
Endearing?
PAEL.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-3.c: I need to stop coming here.
TANX.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.0-0.a: FIRE BIRD! MIGHTY PHOENIX! WHERE IS YOUR WEAPON?
TANX.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.0-1.c: I... don't really need one? I can do more damage with a snap of my fingers than I ever could with a sword.
TANX.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.0-2.a: YOU CAN SNAP YOUR FINGERS [jitter]AND[/jitter] HAVE A SWORD! HERE! TRY IT!!
PURPLE IS A MIGHTY FLAME! TAKE A WEAPON!! MAKE IT STRONGER!!!
TANX.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-2.a:
YES!!!
[i][font_size=22]Tanx lunges at the Wildfire enthusiastically.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-3.c: [i][font_size=22]The Wildfire holds back her flames, meeting Tanx's fervor with nimble footwork and martial arts.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-4.a: YOU ARE STRONG, LITTLE BIRD!! TAKE A WEAPON! LET'S FIGHT AGAIN!
TANX.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.2-5.c:
Ha... ha...
Okay... sure. I'm having fun.
Oh, my. Aren't you just an [jitter][b]adorable[/b][/jitter] little thing?
Blanch
I would. Not describe myself with any of those words.
Continue
You look a little stiff, dearie.
Acknowledge
Has anybody ever told you that you're absolutely terrifying?
Continue
[i][font_size=22]The spire reverberates with Tezcatara's laughter.[/font_size][/i]
If it isn't my favorite little one! Come in and have a seat. I've got something special for you.
Are you still scared of me, little bird?
Tell the truth

Can I be honest?
You're very nice. And that's somehow scarier?
Continue
You're not used to kindness, are you?
Deny
Not from a giant grinning Hallow's Eve haybale ghost. No offense.
Continue
None taken, dear.

You know, that flame of yours is very special.
I didn't know any trace of it still remained.
Question
My dad was a deadbeat wannabe sorcerer. That's not special, it's just unlucky.
Continue
Oh, dearie. Your fire goes back [i]much[/i] farther than that. I might be the only one who still remembers.
Continue
It's a terrible power you've inherited. I can't [jitter][b]wait[/b][/jitter] to see what you'll do with it.

You'll have to go easy on her, dear. Holding a grudge too long isn't good for you.
And besides, you share a common goal.
Get annoyed

You keep talking about things I don't know about like I should know about them even though you know I don't.
Are you just making fun of me?
Continue

You're right, dearie. I shouldn't run my mouth so much. We wouldn't want to spoil anything.
[sine]Hee hee hee...[/sine]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDF: Hey! You're the guy in charge here, right? This place is kinda swarming with monsters.
And? What concern is that to me?
Uh. They're, like, literally outside that door?
And they're getting out and attacking people. It's definitely a problem.
For you, perhaps. But I only see one nuisance before me. And it's time I removed it.
Didn't expect to see me again, did you, asshole?
I held on to some dim hope.
Too bad for you. I'm not going down without a fight.
Go to hell, you smug son of a bitch!
You can go first, and tell me how it is.
You shouldn't have picked this fight. I don't quit. And I only have to get lucky once.
Are you so sure about that?
Why am I beset by such persistent insects?
[jitter][b]BECAUSE YOU KEEP KILLING PEOPLE YOU GODDAMN MANIAC[/b][/jitter]
Hey there, little firebird. You headed to the top?
Why don't you and me make a deal?
That's literally the sketchiest thing I've ever heard in my life.
What, you think I'm gonna trick you? What'd I gain from that?
The boss man and I don't exactly see eye to eye.
Helpin' you helps me, you follow?
VAKKU.talk.THEWILDFIRE-THE_WILDFIRE.1-0r: You know what I like about you, kid? You're [jitter]agreeable[/jitter].
You know, kid... if you wanna make a more [i]permanent[/i] arrangement...
I could help you get that revenge you're after.
I thought you wanted me going after the Architect. Why have you been holding out?
I know a lot of things. That's why I'm so good at [jitter]helping people in need[/jitter].
